title: Cycle Explorer
description: A child follows the water, rock, or plant life cycle and taps where it starts again.
learningObjectives: Explain how a cycle moves from one stage to the next
Find where the water, rock, or plant life cycle starts again

events.name: stage_selected
events.description: The child selected a stage of the cycle.

events.name: cycle_completed
events.description: The child returned to the first stage of the cycle.

tutorGuide.intro: This cycle returns to its start. Follow the four stages, then tap the first one.
steps: Read the four stages in order.
Tap stage 1, the start of the loop.
observationPrompts: What happens after the last stage?
Where does the cycle return to the start?

misconceptions.belief: A cycle ends at the last stage and does not start again.
misconceptions.response: The last stage feeds the first one. Water collects and can evaporate again, rock can melt again, and fruit holds new seeds.

misconceptions.belief: The water cycle uses up the water.
misconceptions.response: The same water moves. It changes from liquid to vapor and back.

hints: Tap stage 1. That is where the loop begins again.
Water begins with evaporation, rock with magma, and a plant with a seed.

successCriteria.description: Selected a stage of the cycle
Returned to the first stage and finished the cycle

accessibility.screenReaderSummary: Four stages of a cycle. Tap a stage to hear what happens. The first stage starts the loop again.
